#!/usr/bin/env ruby

require "optparse"

options = { verbose: false }

parser = OptionParser.new do |opts|
  opts.banner = "Usage: ruby wordcount.rb [--verbose] FILENAME"
  opts.on("-v", "--verbose", "Also print the number of lines") do
    options[:verbose] = true
  end
end

begin
  parser.parse!
  abort(parser.to_s) unless ARGV.length == 1

  text = File.read(ARGV.fetch(0))
  puts "Words: #{text.split.length}"
  puts "Lines: #{text.lines.length}" if options[:verbose]
rescue OptionParser::ParseError, Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
  warn "Error: #{e.message}"
  exit 1
end
